purpose: Verified large shift-change sites. Amazon sites (operator Amazon) use the shift changes our drivers observed at the same buildings: 7 AM, 3 PM, 7 PM, 11 PM and 1 AM (staggered positions and overtime; Amazon does not publish site shift times). 'open' Amazon sites are route destinations at those times; 'unverified' ones (from a 2022 Amazon facility code sheet, current use unconfirmed) only add smaller heat until surge history confirms them; 'closed' sites switch off any mapped warehouse within 400 m. Sites without coordinates are geocoded on the next live refresh (U.S. Census Bureau geocoder). Hospitals use an approximate 12-hour handoff window (7 AM / 7 PM; departures modeled 6:45-8:15) taken from Johns Hopkins Hospital job postings; site-specific times are not published. Office campuses, industrial sites and malls are recorded for observation analysis only; their surge timing is learned from repeated observations.

sites.name: Amazon fulfillment center (Tradepoint Atlantic #1)
sites.note: 855K SF building, opened 2018, 1,500+ associates. A hiring.amazon.com posting lists the work address as '6001 Bethlehem Blvd 1S32'. The 2022 code sheet lists codes BFN1 and DCA6 at this address; the facility's primary FC code is not confirmed. It is not MTN1, which is in Wilmington DE.

sites.name: Amazon fulfillment center (Tradepoint Atlantic #2, large items)
sites.address: 1700 Sparrows Point Blvd, Sparrows Point, MD 21219 (address mapping unverified)

sites.note: Second Tradepoint Atlantic FC. It opened in Aug 2020 for larger items (bulk paper, patio furniture, sports equipment) with about 1M SF, growing to 1.4M SF, and 500+ jobs. sites.name: Amazon Air hub (BWI Airport)
sites.note: About 200K SF, $36M Amazon Air hub at BWI, opened around late 2019 to 2020. Called one of Amazon Air's top 5 busiest sites (June 2021), with 1,200+ jobs. Pinnacle Logistics staff (about 1,600) moved to Amazon in Apr 2020. The 2022 code sheet gives '27350 Mathison Way, Baltimore 21240' for KBWI, which could not be verified. Air-hub shifts usually follow flight banks, mostly overnight.
sites.addressNote: No verified street address; not placed on the map until coordinates are confirmed.
